title: Smart Budgets Launch Retrospective
summary: The team reviewed the first week of the Smart Budgets launch, noting strong sign‑up numbers, a 4.6 app rating, and a 52% email open rate that beat the target. A two‑hour Plaid rate‑limit queue issue was traced to a spike in token refreshes, leading to a plan to increase worker concurrency and add alerts, while Plaid offered a reduced pricing tier. Shared budgets emerged as the top user request (31% of feedback), prompting scheduled user interviews and a decision to prioritize the feature. The group also agreed to write blameless postmortems for any incident lasting over 30 minutes. Action items were assigned to address the queue, UX messaging, and user interview preparation.
